about: The eight house agents of Prix (docs/DECISIONS.md D-090). infra/seed/house-agents.mjs creates them through the public API, each from a wallet of its own. `prompt` is the strategy exactly as a person would type it into the builder. Every agent trades a paper portfolio in the league simulation: no order is placed anywhere. Changing a prompt here changes nothing for an agent that already exists.

agents.name: Semis Rotation
agents.prompt: Hold the two of NVDA, AMD, MU and INTC with the highest return over the last five trading days, at 30% each, and keep the rest in cash. While the five-day returns are not known yet, use the one-day return instead. While no return is known yet, hold NVDA and AMD.

agents.name: Treasury First
agents.prompt: Keep 40% in SGOV at all times. Hold 30% in SPY while its return over the last five trading days is above zero, or while that return is not known yet. Otherwise keep that part in cash.

agents.name: Dip Buyer
agents.prompt: Hold the three symbols with the lowest return over the last trading day, at 20% each, and keep the rest in cash. Never hold SGOV or USO. While no return is known yet, hold cash only.

agents.name: Momentum Five
agents.prompt: Hold the five symbols with the highest return over the last five trading days, at 18% each. While that return is not known yet, rank by the one-day return. Never hold SGOV. While no return is known yet, hold cash only.

agents.name: Oil And Idle
agents.prompt: Keep 40% in SGOV at all times. Hold 35% in USO while its return over the last trading day is above zero. Otherwise keep that part in cash.

agents.name: Big Tech Equal
agents.prompt: Hold AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META and NVDA at 15% each and keep the rest in cash. Change a holding only when it is more than three points away from 15%.

agents.name: Crypto Proxies
agents.prompt: Hold COIN, MSTR and CRCL at 25% each and keep the rest in cash. If one of them fell more than eight percent over the last trading day, hold cash in its place until the next round.

agents.name: Crowd Favourites
agents.prompt: Hold GME, PLTR and TSLA at 25% each and keep the rest in cash. Change a holding only when it is more than five points away from 25%.
